question:
In the following figure, AD bisects angle BAC. Find the length (in cm) of BD.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3fa09ffb8577034c6440d2ac88250968246daac632aa0f5438c5a616a9656e5d.png]
solution:
**Given:**

AD bisects angle BAC

**Concept used:**

Here, in ΔPQR, PL bisects ∠RPQ. According to the Angle Bisector Theorem, {RL over LQ} = {PR over PQ}

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0394bc7ea9c7b692d7b2ab33dc11e1e02313d396f8b5e0b08ff07a4d648226a9.png] 

 

 

**Calculation:**

**Similarly, **AD bisects angle BAC

{BD over DC} = {AB over AC}

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3fa09ffb8577034c6440d2ac88250968246daac632aa0f5438c5a616a9656e5d.png] 

According to the concept,

[6/(2x - 3)] = [(x - 2)/x]

⇒ 6x = 2x² - 4x - 3x + 6

⇒ 6x = 2x2 - 7x + 6

⇒ 0 = 2x2 - 7x + 6 - 6x

⇒ 2x2 - 13x + 6 = 0

⇒ 2x2 - 12x - x + 6 = 0

⇒ 2x(x - 6) - 1(x - 6) = 0

⇒ (x - 6)(2x - 1) = 0

So, x = 6, 1/2

For x = 1/2

BD = 1/2 - 2

⇒ - 3/2 As the value of a side cannot be negative

So, x = 6

Now,

BD = 6 - 2

⇒ 4 cm

**∴ The length (in cm) of BD is 4 cm.**
